name: QuickBorgmatic
author: Benoît HERVIER
description: Borgmatic backup freshness monitor: bar icon that warns when the newest backup is older than a threshold, with a per-repository popup

barWidget.description: Backup freshness for every borgmatic repository

schema.label: borgmatic executable
